title: Journal redraws over itself and has no height limit; bag-full can block a key or the ending
details: (Found in the 2026-09-26 code review, owner asked for all of these to be fixed) JournalPanel.build() never clears its Graphics. A full bag after winning a mini-game gives no key (replay needed), and a full bag would block the reward box and so the ending.

thread.author: agent
thread.text: Journal draws cleanly and scrolls; keys are recorded before items are given, and the volunteer takes the 3 keys back before giving the box, so a full bag can never block the ending.

resolution.test: tests/e2e/journal.spec.js › FB-0041a: with 15 long entries, the journal panel stays inside 960x540 and becomes scrollable
